content: 7 boonnao paida kidaꞌo Tominkaru toꞌoran idi
Uruu daunaꞌan õabatan diiwaꞌo parada-karu Tominkaru Dapuꞌu ikiꞌo kian 7 angelnao ati, “Umako ushootaꞌanaꞌa naa wuruꞌu 7 boon zoꞌo kidaꞌoraz Tominkaru toꞌoranuz, imiꞌi baara iti.”

Kiwiitapaꞌo angel makon ushootan naa paboonan wazoo imiꞌi baara iti. Sariapa kachamaꞌidiikiaꞌo kaziwaꞌo kabisho-karu kaawan wunao idaꞌatiꞌi, kainaꞌoraz kichanaꞌiki-kiaꞌo panaꞌaokazi, kainaariba kida ĩꞌidaꞌa, naꞌiki dawukainaouz toma-kariwai uruu kawanuꞌo ati.
Udaunaꞌan 2nd Angel shootan paboonan wazoo paran baoko iti. Sariapa wunu tanawatinan mawakaꞌo pidan izain kawan uaidinpan, naꞌiki ipai aimaakannao mashaapaꞌo paran baokoꞌo mawakan.
Udaunaꞌan 3rd Angel shootan paboonan wazoo waꞌozinao naꞌiki wunu nunudapainao kida diꞌiti, ipai ĩtanawatinan izai nii.
Õabata Angel taapaꞌoraz wunu kian,

content.text: uruu idiꞌo ukauꞌan putuza-kidan izai ĩꞌati ĩwinipinaa nii.”

content: Uruu daunaꞌan õabata parada-karu altar diꞌikiꞌo kian.

content.text: “Oo Naobanai Tominkaru,pugaru mishi umanawunuꞌo nii manawun,
sakitapa naꞌiki kaiman pushaꞌapatan aimaakanpupatakaꞌutanuz ĩdyaun.”

content: Udaunaꞌan 4th angel shootan paboonan wazoo kamoo diꞌiti, kamoo wiichan, wiicha manawun uwiichauzon ai, ukawaodan ipai pidannao pawiichan idi.

Ipai pidannao kawaoda-kariwainao uwiichan idi, oiaiman kida ĩparadan Tominkaru ati, utaapadan idi wuru kida shaꞌapanuꞌu patakaꞌutin-kinai kidaz. Upuꞌu mazan aonaa ĩtanawatinan paꞌoian ai, naꞌiki aonaa ĩdakotan Tominkaru umanawunuꞌo nii.

Udaunaꞌan 5th angel shootan paboonan wazoo kichanaꞌiki-kiaꞌo panaꞌaokazi taba paawa iti, ipai amazada marutan ukazowautapa-kizi ii, naꞌiki ipai upidanannao kuzowan paninoba kida, ĩbaiaapan idi kaziwaꞌo kabisho-karu.
Oiaiman kida ĩparadan Tominkaru aokazi iaꞌo dauꞌan, pamada kida kabishon naꞌiki ukaziwan idi tuukii manawun. Upuꞌu aonaa ĩkashaꞌoran naꞌiki aonaa ĩtanawatinan Tominkaru diꞌiti paꞌoian kida ai.
Udaunaꞌan 6th angel shootan paboonan wazoo udaruꞌo waꞌozi Euphrates iti, sariapa waꞌozi maaran arada, kingnao pasoldyaannao tuma, waꞌati-kizi nii waoko iki.

Udaunaꞌan õtukapa idikinaudaꞌu oiaꞌo doronainao, kibaronao kawanuꞌo ĩaidinpan kida, baudaꞌapa koditan Dragon dako iki, baꞌoran koditan kichanaꞌiki-kiaꞌo panaꞌaokazi dako iki, naꞌiki baꞌoran koditan mariidinauzo prophet dako iki.

Wuruꞌu oiaꞌo doronainaouz kainaꞌaꞌo ĩmaꞌozakan taa-kao ĩshaꞌapata-kinaa nii umanawun kidaꞌo aimaakan. Ĩmakon nii ipai kingnao kawanaꞌati imiꞌi baara ainaouz ĩbaokopataꞌazon ĩdyaun mizaataakaꞌo nii Tominkaru umanawunuꞌo tuma, ukamoon kaawan dono. Naꞌapainiꞌo nii Tominkaru winian ĩdyaun tuukii.

Jesus kian, “Puabata! Õwaꞌatin nii koidimiki kaawan kawan, konaukiaꞌo nii pidan mashaapaꞌoraz pokodapa naꞌiki taapaꞌoraz pakamichan minziiwapaꞌa naa, aonaa kizi uchiꞌikaꞌanpan makamichan-daun, udaunaꞌan ubaꞌazootinan pidannao ati.”
Udaunaꞌan oiaꞌo doronainao baokopatan ipai kingnao amazada idaꞌati dakota-kariwaiz Hebrew idaꞌan Armageddon kii.
Udaunaꞌan 7th angel shootan paboonan wazoo doko iti. Diiwaꞌo idaꞌan parada-karu koditan umanawunuꞌoraz manawun tabai diꞌiki, Tominkaru Dapuꞌu iaꞌo diꞌiki. Ukian, “Aizii ipaiꞌi naazu.”

Sariapa kan-kan-kiaꞌo naꞌiki toroanaru turuinan, naꞌiki imiꞌi baara nakainan maꞌozakaꞌo idaꞌan manawun. Aonaa naꞌapainim imiꞌi baara nakainauzon maꞌozakaꞌa naa manawun diꞌoraꞌa kawanuꞌu, kiwiiniꞌo pidannao toma-kao diꞌikiꞌo ai.

Imiꞌi nakainan idi umanawunuꞌoraz donoi Babylon tadaꞌokan idikinaudaꞌu, naꞌiki uruu idi kapam ipai baꞌoran donoinao imiꞌi baaraꞌaꞌoraz mainaabatinan. Aonaa Tominkaru manyukunuutan Babylon, uruu idi utuza-kidan naa ipai wine wuruꞌu patoꞌoranuz pakoopon zoꞌiki oꞌati.
Ipai imiꞌi baara paran ii kidaꞌo mainaabatinan, naꞌiki ipai midukuo kida mainaabatinan kapam.

Dadara tuꞌuz kidaꞌo wunu kuba kawan, waotan imiꞌi baara ati pidannao paawa ati kida, ĩkimishan kida 100 pounds. Tominkaru patakaꞌutan idi pidannao tuukii, wuru idiꞌi uwaota-kidanuz dadara tuuꞌuz kidaꞌoraz wunu ĩpaawa ati, tuukii ĩdakoautapan uruu.
